text: Neha - driving test 14 Nov, 3rd attempt. v nervous. text good luck that morning
Rafael's daughter starts reception Mon. he's more wound up than she is lol
car MOT due 03/11 - book @ garage on Elm Rd. tyres too?
Zofia - results day for her MSc 21st of Nov. ask how it went the day after
Marcus + Jess graduation @ cathedral 12 Dec, both of them same ceremony. card?
Hadiza passed theory test!! practical booked for Jan. congrats

Tunde / audition for the youth orchestra - Sat 8 Nov, 10am @ the conservatoire. dad (Malik) says he's practising 4hrs a day, barely eating dinner. Tunde v quiet abt it, didn't want to talk. cello teacher Mrs Olsen thinks he's ready. good luck msg the night before, then ask how it went the day after. Malik also mentioned results come out a week after
Aidan's lad - GCSE mocks w/c 17/11. Aidan stressing more than the kid tbh
dentist 9:15 Thurs. then post office w/ parcel
Laura Murphy - Lolly - finished her PhD viva yesterday, minor corrections only. send flowers
Ignacio's grad ceremony cancelled, strike. they're doing a garden party instead 30 Nov
Aditi - son Kemal first swimming badge sat. she's dead proud

Chidi - re-sitting maths A level, exam 6th of June. struggling w/ stats, says it's not clicking and he's sick of it. mum on his case daily. he wants medicine at Leeds, needs an A. offer to go thru past papers w/ him the wk before, maybe Sundays @ library. also he's doing shifts at Tesco Thurs/Fri so not those days
Salma's twins start nursery 4/11. she goes back to work a week after. check in w/ her that Fri
renew passport - expires 02/02. photos first
Nadia - Grade 5 piano exam 25 Nov. cat Pickle sat on the keys during our call lol

Petra and Kemal - daughter Eva's graduation from Leeds 15 July. they're driving up the day before, staying 2 nights at a B&B nr the uni. Kemal's mum coming too, first time she's been north. Eva did law, already has a training contract w/ a firm in Manchester starting Sept. Petra wants a photo book of her uni years - I said I'd dig out pics. Should send them to Petra by end of June
Archie = into climbing now, bouldering 3x wk. birthday 8 Dec - chalk bag wd go down well
Jakub - CSCS card test next Tues. need to ask afterwards if he passed, he needs it for the new site job
Rebecca - Becca - got into Bristol for vet med!! letter came this morning. her mum cried apparently

Fiona's driving test is off - examiner sick, found out in the car park. 3rd time it's been moved. she's gutted, took the day off work for it and her instructor charged anyway. rebooked for 19/12 but that's the week of her work Xmas do. I need to text her that morning, and maybe take her out for a practice drive the weekend before
Eva/ citizenship test Wed. asked me to quiz her on the history bits the day before. I'm doing that Tues eve
Dana's boy Aidan - first day @ secondary Wed, 3 Sep. she's nervous about the bus. ask her how it went that evening
Matteo Rossi - bar exam results out 28/10. don't forget to message him that afternoon
Aneesh off to Edinburgh for uni next month. his mum's sorting the flat
bin day moved to Weds from next wk
Ali - theory test tmrw 10am. he says he hasn't revised, classic Ali
Zhang - sister Dana graduates 5th of Dec, Zhang flying out to Shanghai for it 2 Dec, back the 9th
James' daughter lost her first tooth! tooth fairy rate negotiations ongoing

Agnieszka - youngest starting Year 1 / eldest sitting 11+ on 13 Sep. bit much for one week, she sounded knackered. husband Jakub away w/ work til the 20th so she's doing all the runs alone. eldest is calm, Agnieszka isn't. call her the weekend after, and maybe offer to do pick up Thurs
self assessment - deadline 31/01. receipts in the blue folder
Francesca's recital rehearsal moved to Sat. actual recital 22 Nov @ St Mary's, 7pm
Hadiza - gluten free, remember for the grad dinner
Malik's niece Salma passed her 11+ - got into the grammar. family v chuffed
Rafael - reminded me abt his mum's 70th 16 Mar. maybe chip in for a present w/ his sister Francesca

Marcus - nervous re: final presentation for his design course 3 Dec, 15 mins to a panel. hasn't slept properly in a wk. girlfriend Laura helping him rehearse. said he'll text me after. if not, ask the next day. graduation then in Jan, his parents flying in from Lagos for it
Jess - dog Biscuit had op on leg yesterday. she's shattered. check how he's doing Fri
book flights for Krakow before prices go up. aiming 14-18 Feb
Laura - kid's school play 10/12, she's a sheep. Laura making the costume, panicking
Kemal's dad - retired as a driving instructor after 30 yrs. party at the cricket club 1st of Nov, I'm going
Aidan - eye test for licence renewal booked 7/11. needs glasses prob
Neha's brother Rafael - got his driving licence back after 6 months. she's relieved
Chidi + girlfriend Aditi both sitting ACCA paper 1 Dec. revising together, drives each other mad
Petra: daughter's ballet grade exam Sat morning. Petra forgot the leotard last time so reminder to her the day before
pick up suit from dry cleaner before Thurs. grad photos Fri
Ignacio - learner permit test passed today. first lesson w/ instructor 9 Nov. he wants to buy a car straight after - maybe dad's old Fiesta

Zofia's mum - hip op last wk, recovering at Zofia's. Zofia juggling that + thesis deadline 30/11. she's exhausted, sounded close to tears. sister Petra supposed to help but lives in Bristol. mum can't do stairs so sleeping in the living room. pop round w/ food this wk, maybe the lasagne. Zofia veggie
Tunde - got into the orchestra!! first rehearsal 10 Jan, concert 14 Mar
Nadia - teaches primary @ St Anne's. Year 2. loves it but says ofsted dread
Salma - kid's results day was today, GCSEs. all 7s+ except maths. didn't say much more
Fiona - Fi - does a lot of open water swimming. hates the gym
exam re-sit timetable - check uni portal 01/12

Dr Banerjee (Aditi's dad) - turns out he's the external examiner for Jess's PhD viva lol small world. Jess's viva 18 Feb in Cambridge. she's terrified, thesis is on soil microbes and she thinks ch.4 is weak. her partner Matteo booked a dinner for afterwards. wish her luck the morning of, and drinks after if she's up for it - the Fri after maybe
Archie's sister Neha - just started uni @ Glasgow, homesick. Archie worried abt her
James - learning Polish for wife Agnieszka's family. B1 exam in June
Agnieszka - eldest passed the 11+! results came 10 Oct. need to send congrats card
Eva - passed citizenship test. ceremony 3 Dec, she asked me to come. I'm going, booked half day
cancel gym membership - notice period 1 month so do it by 30/10

Rebecca + partner Ali expecting, due 4 May. Becca still doing finals in April, poor thing, morning sickness bad. exams 14/04 - 25/04. her mum moving in for May. remind me to send a care pack a week before exams - snacks, ginger biscuits, nice tea. Ali's mate Archie doing the nursery decorating

Matteo - nephew first day @ nursery tmrw. Matteo dropping him off as sister Nadia on night shifts at the hospital. kid only 2, cries at any goodbye. Matteo dreading it, bought him a dinosaur backpack as a bribe. ask how drop off went, and whether Nadia's rota changes after Christmas
